title: Ninja Dual Zone £119.99, Kindle £119.99 and Oral-B iO3 £49.99
description: Wednesday's best UK deals: Ninja Dual Zone air fryer £119.99, Kindle at a record £119.99, Oral-B iO3 £49.99 and a Kärcher window vac £38.99.
intro:
**Today's pick is the Ninja Foodi Dual Zone air fryer at £119.99 on Amazon, the lowest price TechRadar has seen for it all year, with the new Kindle holding at a record-low £119.99.** It's a home-heavy day: a Ninja knife block, the Oral-B iO Series 3, a Kärcher window vac and a small Levoit air purifier are all cut, and two picks are cleaning gadgets in the spirit of this week's [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight.

All prices below were published on 24 November in TechRadar's UK and Amazon UK Black Friday live blogs, so check the product page before you pay. Buy now or wait? Black Friday is the day after tomorrow (27 November), but Amazon's Black Friday Week prices are already in place and run to Cyber Monday, so there's little to gain by holding off on anything here.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L air fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: Two independent drawers, so chips and chicken finish at the same time, which suits families of three to five. TechRadar says £119.99 is the lowest it has seen all year. Smaller households should look at our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi StaySharp knife block with integrated sharpener
deals.note: A five-knife block with a sharpener built into the slot, so the blades get honed as you use them. A practical gift for someone who cooks a lot. More in our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Kärcher WV2 Plus N window vac
deals.note: Sucks condensation and streaks off windows, mirrors and shower screens, and earns its keep on misty winter mornings. Under £40 is a good price for the 'Plus' kit, which includes the spray bottle and cloth.

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 electric toothbrush
deals.note: Oral-B's entry iO brush, with the quieter magnetic motor and pressure light. Ignore the £175 'was', which it rarely sells at; under £50 is still a fair price for an iO. See our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Levoit Core Mini air purifier
deals.note: A small HEPA purifier for a bedroom, nursery or home office, handy for dust and pet hair. It's too small for an open-plan living room, so size up if that's where it's going.

deals.name: Shark Stratos cordless vacuum (IZ400UK)
deals.note: Still £199 at Currys, about half what it usually sells for (the £419.99 'was' is inflated). Its anti-hair-wrap brush is the reason to buy it if you have pets. Check the Amazon compare link before you pay, and see [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (2026, 16GB)
deals.note: The new basic Kindle at a record low, and TechRadar doesn't expect it to go lower before next year's Prime Day. Pair it with a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](/guides/kindle-unlimited-free-trial-uk/), or compare models in our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Bose QuietComfort Earbuds
deals.note: Strong noise cancelling for the commute at under £100, and TechRadar says some colours are at a record low. If you listen on the train, an [Audible trial](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus an indoor camera for less than the doorbell usually costs alone. Remember you'll want a Ring subscription to save recordings. More in our [Ring doorbell Black Friday guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Probably not. The Kindle and Dual Zone prices are the best of the year, and TechRadar expects the Kindle to stay at this level rather than drop again. The one to watch is the Shark Stratos: Currys has it at £199, but Amazon sometimes matches Shark prices late in Black Friday Week, so tap the compare link first. For the dates of every retailer's sale, see [when is Black Friday 2026 UK](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## This week's spotlight

Our [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight covers the cordless and robot vacuums at genuine lows and the prices worth paying. Dyson fans should also see our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/), and Shark fans our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

Not a Prime member? Some Amazon deal prices need Prime, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the rest of Black Friday Week. For everything else, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) or our [Black Friday live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).
